# catfinder.app

## About
CatFinder helps you identify and learn about cat breeds. Browse 74 cat breeds with photos, characteristics, temperament, and care information. Available in English, Spanish (/es/), and German (/de/).

## URLs
- Homepage: https://catfinder.app/
- All breeds A-Z: https://catfinder.app/breeds/
- Search & filter breeds: https://catfinder.app/search/
- Breed quiz: https://catfinder.app/quiz/
- Compare breeds: https://catfinder.app/compare/
- Breed comparisons: https://catfinder.app/compare/comparisons/
- Guides: https://catfinder.app/articles/
- FAQ: https://catfinder.app/faq/
- Breed pages: https://catfinder.app/breeds/<breed-slug>/ (e.g. https://catfinder.app/breeds/maine-coon/)
- Breed data (JSON): https://catfinder.app/data/breeds.json
